name: ai-job-hunter
description: Local-first AI Job Hunter: discover, match, and apply to jobs from your CV.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @job-hunter/api" "npm run dev -w @job-hunter/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @job-hunter/shared && npm run build -w @job-hunter/database && npm run build -w @job-hunter/api && npm run build -w @job-hunter/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start -w @job-hunter/api" "npm run start -w @job-hunter/web"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @job-hunter/api --if-present && npm run lint -w @job-hunter/web --if-present
